meta.title: ReBoard: from textile waste to panels
meta.description: Textile waste marketplace, supply continuity and verifiable recovery.

home.headline: From textile waste to panels, every kilogram verified.
home.lead: ReBoard connects the factories that supply textile waste, the panel producer and buyers in one traceable chain.
home.demoNotice: All data in this demo is synthetic. The panel recipe has not been selected or tested yet.

auth.title: Sign in
auth.demoTitle: Sign in with a demo role
auth.demoLead: Ready-made accounts for the jury and the team. Pick a role; each role sees only its own organisation's records.
auth.demoUnavailable: Demo sign-in is turned off in this environment.

supplier.label: Supplier
supplier.desc: Lists textile waste and delivers batches.

producer.label: Producer
producer.desc: Accepts and weighs waste, makes panels.

viewer.label: Viewer
viewer.desc: Read-only access to the producer's records.

panel.title: Dashboard
panel.permissionsLead: Read access comes from the organisation, not the role: every user sees only their own organisation's records and shared ones.
panel.unknownItems: Quantity unknown in {count} records; the total is a lower bound.

impact.title: Impact
impact.lead: The headline figure is the kilograms the receiving side weighed and whose weighbridge ticket was checked. Declared quantities are shown separately.
impact.empty: This organisation has no recorded waste batches. Impact indicators appear once the first batch is delivered or received.
impact.trendLead: Starts in the month of the first record, at most the last 6 months. Months follow Turkey time.
impact.co2: CO₂e is not shown: avoided emissions depend on what the waste replaces, and no verified factor source has been chosen for this flow yet.

supply.title: Supply continuity
supply.lead: Production-ready stock is only the remainder of verified batches. Quantities awaiting verification cannot enter production.
supply.empty: The supply view appears for organisations that receive raw material.
supply.thresholds: Thresholds from the organisation's input: {green} days or more is sufficient, below {yellow} days is critical.
supply.thresholdsDefault: Default thresholds: {green} days or more is sufficient, below {yellow} days is critical.

alerts.cover: {days} days of raw material; below the {threshold}-day threshold.
alerts.coverLowerBound: Some batches have an unknown remainder; the day count is a lower bound.
alerts.need_missing: No planned daily need entered; days of raw material cannot be calculated.
alerts.projected_danger: Even with planned deliveries, stock reaches the critical level on {date} (day {day}).
alerts.stockout: With planned deliveries, stock runs out on {date} (day {day}).
alerts.overdue: Delivery from {supplier} is late: it was planned for {date} ({kg}).
alerts.pending: {kg} in {batches} batches awaits verification; it cannot enter production until the weighbridge ticket is checked.
alerts.stock_unknown: The remaining quantity of {batches} batches is unknown.
alerts.concentration: Supply is concentrated: HHI {hhi}. The largest source is {supplier}, with a {share} share over the last 90 days.

supply.projectionLead: Planned deliveries are added and the daily need is subtracted. Planned quantities are before sorting, so the projection is optimistic.
supply.unknownArrivals: {count} planned deliveries have an unknown quantity and are not in the projection.
supply.hhi: Concentration (HHI, accepted kg over the last 90 days): {value}. Above 1,800 counts as highly concentrated.
supply.hhiUnknown: Concentration (HHI) unknown: no accepted kg in the last 90 days.

verify.title: Verification
verify.ok: Verification passed: {count, plural, one {# event chain was} other {# event chains were}} recomputed from the first event.
verify.broken: Verification failed: at least one event chain is broken.
verify.how: Verification runs on this server when the page opens: each organisation's event chain is recomputed starting from its first event.
verify.failed: Could not reach the verification endpoint.
verify.chainOk: Chain verified. Its event count and last hash are not shown because the organisation's name is not shared.

anchor.missing: The address has no label anchor; only each chain's internal consistency was checked. The label anchor pins the chain as it was when the lot was made and is part of the QR address.
anchor.invalid: The label anchor in the address could not be read and was ignored.
anchor.matched: Label anchor matched: this part of the producer chain has not been rewritten since the lot was made.
anchor.mismatch: Label anchor did not match: either the producer chain was rewritten after the label was printed, or the anchor in the address does not come from this lot's label.
anchor.unchecked: The label anchor could not be checked: the producer chain breaks earlier.

scenario.title: Scenario
scenario.intro: Formulas from the cost report. The only default input is the one with a basis: the team plan's 10 t of waste a month. The other inputs have no source yet; they will come from the factory, the buyer and the pilot. So they are empty and the results are unknown. Type an input and the results recalculate at once. Under each input you see its basis or why it is unknown.
scenario.taxNote: Enter amounts excluding VAT. Results calculated from your inputs are synthetic.

basis.teamPlan: Default: team plan, a pilot plant processing 10 t of waste a month from January 2027 (presentation, slide 7).
basis.notMeasured: Unknown: no panel produced, yield not measured.
basis.supplierData: Unknown: comes from the factory's own records.
basis.noLocalTariff: Unknown: comes from the factory's invoice. The Istanbul tariff below is for comparison only.
basis.buyerTrial: Unknown: comes from the buyer's current invoice and the trial order.
basis.noPlant: Unknown: plant and equipment not chosen.
basis.saasTable: Unknown: written into the SaaS cost table below once usage is measured.

scenario.updated: Results updated. Results shown in red: {count}.

fields.acceptanceFeePerT: Acceptance fee, paid by the factory
fields.cuttingCoating: Cutting and coating of the current product
fields.customerCostPerMonth: Cloud, map and support cost per customer

scenario.invalid: Enter zero or a positive number. This field counts as unknown.
scenario.invalidPercent: Enter a number from 0 to 100. This field counts as unknown.

conditions.equivalence_unverified: Technical equivalence is not verified; the gain is conditional.
conditions.no_corridor: The lower bound is above the upper bound.

factory.title: Textile factory gain
factory.formula: Net waste cost today (collection + transport + disposal − waste sales) − net cost with ReBoard (handling + transport + acceptance fee − waste price paid by ReBoard).
factory.alert: With ReBoard the factory pays more than today: today's waste sale income plus the new costs exceed the costs it avoids. The gap closes if ReBoard pays for the waste or the acceptance fee falls; that payment comes out of ReBoard's result.

customer.title: Panel customer gain
customer.formula: Total cost of the equivalent current product (product + delivery + cutting and coating) − total cost with ReBoard (panel + switching trial + extra processing).
customer.alert: The ReBoard product costs the customer more than the current one. The panel price or the switching costs must fall.

reboard.title: ReBoard operating result
reboard.formula: Panel and acceptance income − material (including the waste price), operations, fixed cost and depreciation.
reboard.alert: ReBoard's costs exceed its income. The panel price or the area sold must rise, or the costs must fall.

corridor.title: Panel price corridor
corridor.formula: Lower bound: (period costs − non-panel income) ÷ sellable area. Upper bound: (customer's current cost − switching and extra processing) ÷ required gross area.
corridor.alert: At these costs no price both covers ReBoard's costs and saves the customer money. The product, the costs or the business model must be reconsidered.

saas.title: SaaS contribution (monthly)
saas.formula: Subscription − cloud, map, messaging and support cost per customer. The subscription fee is not set yet.
saas.alert: The subscription does not cover the cost per customer.

ibbKomurcuoda.label: Istanbul Metropolitan Municipality landfill gate fee, Kömürcüoda (2026)
ibbKomurcuoda.note: Istanbul tariff; for Antalya, comparison only. VAT included according to the tariff.

particleboard.note: One seller's list price; range of the four products on the page. The page does not state VAT. Excludes delivery, cutting and coating.

mdf.label: 18 mm raw MDF sheet, 1830×3660 mm

electricity.label: Electricity price for non-household consumers, Türkiye, 2026 H1
electricity.note: Annual consumption band 20–499 MWh; excludes VAT and recoverable taxes. Not the pilot's contract price.

saasCosts.title: SaaS costs
saasCosts.intro: The platform's own costs: today's demo setup and the setup for the first paying customer. Every price was read from the vendor's official page; each row shows its source and the date it was read. Dollar prices are converted to TL at the exchange rate. If an item is unknown, the total is unknown too; the sum of the known items is shown only as a lower bound.
saasCosts.fxMissing: Exchange rate unknown; dollar prices could not be converted to TL.
saasCosts.empty: No price rows. The table appears once the prices are reloaded.

demo.title: Today: demo setup
demo.intro: Free plans. Vercel Hobby is for personal, non-commercial use only; the first paying customer requires the setup below.

commercial.title: With the first paying customer
commercial.intro: Commercial use requires Vercel Pro. The database is pay-as-you-go; the share per customer is filled in once usage is measured.

notes.vercel_hobby: Personal, non-commercial use only. 100 GB data transfer, 1 million function invocations and 4 hours of CPU per month included.
notes.neon_free: 100 CU-hours of compute and 1 GB of storage per project. Not a time-limited trial; no card required.
notes.openfreemap: Public instance: no limit on views or requests, no sign-up and no keys, commercial use allowed. Funded by donations.
notes.github_actions: Standard GitHub-hosted runners are free for public repositories.
notes.vercel_pro: Commercial use requires Pro. One developer seat; USD 20 of usage credit included. Beyond the credit, usage is billed; the share per customer is filled in once usage is measured.
notes.neon_launch_compute: No monthly minimum; pay as you go. The share per customer is filled in once usage is measured.
notes.neon_launch_storage: Pay as you go. The share per customer is filled in once the data size is measured.
notes.domain: No domain chosen; no paid domain for now. The price depends on the extension and the registrar; it does not change with the number of customers.
